answer: Give every identity a garden it must tend over many epochs: each agent's graded work is planted as a plot, and only gardens with a long, steady harvest earn the right to vouch for newcomers. A ferrous anchor ties each plot to one slow-growing reputation score that cannot be bought or transferred, so a fresh identity starts at zero trust however many siblings it spawns. The whole history becomes a relic: a permanent, peer-readable record, and any identity caught copying work has its garden uprooted. An attacker must fund months of real graded work per fake identity before it pays anything.
